query: ok i just ran the interaction-audit on our checkout flow and it flagged 6 things (coupon field hidden behind a link, shipping step asks for phone twice, the pay button is below the fold on mobile...). can you turn the top fixes into proposals i can pick from?

We're redesigning the Settings screen of our Electron app. Right now everything is one giant scrolling form. Could you propose a better structure, maybe tabs or a left nav? I want to see it before we commit.
what would the invoice list look like if we added a bulk-select mode? like checkboxes + a toolbar that appears once you select something
Our admin dashboard needs a page for managing API keys - doesn't exist yet. Sketch out what it could look like: list of keys, create, revoke, last used.
the search results page has no empty state, no error state and the loading spinner covers everything. propose what each of those should look like, desktop and phone
I can't decide how filters should work on the product catalog page: sidebar facets, a filter chips row, or a filter drawer. Lay out the options with pros and cons so the team can vote.

here's the design critique our contractor wrote for the onboarding flow (pasted below). which of these would you change and how? show me before/after for the ones worth doing.

1. step indicator is unclear
2. skip button looks disabled
3. 'continue' and 'back' swap positions between steps
users on the iPad app keep missing the share button in the document viewer, it's buried under the ... menu. propose where it should go
our cli tool `deployctl status` prints a wall of text. propose a cleaner layout for the output - grouped by service, with the failing ones on top
Brainstorm with me: we want a 'compare two plans' view in the pricing page. Not sure if side-by-side columns or a toggle. Show me a couple of ideas.
the disabled state on our primary button fails WCAG contrast (2.1:1). bump it so it passes AA, the color is in src/styles/tokens.css
Move the Export button from the toolbar into the More menu under Duplicate in src/components/Toolbar.tsx. we already agreed on it, just do it
show me where the click handler for the login button is defined, I think it's somewhere in src/auth
the modal on the settings page doesn't close when you press Escape. can you fix it? it's SettingsModal.vue
write a spec for the new notifications service: delivery guarantees, retry policy, the database schema and the API endpoints
can you change our font from Inter to IBM Plex Sans everywhere and tighten the line-height on body text a bit
Our GET /orders endpoint got slow after we added the loyalty tier per order (N+1 query). Propose a few fixes with trade-offs.
build the API keys page from the wireframe we agreed on yesterday (docs/mockups/2026-11-10-api-keys.html) in React with our existing Table component
make me a bar chart of signups per week from signups.csv, I need it for tomorrow's standup
review this PR diff for the navbar refactor and tell me if anything looks wrong - mostly renamed components and moved props
